header.title: Clarity in the chaos of early parenthood

whyBabyHealth.description: Parenting a newborn is overwhelming. We built BabyHealth to cut through the noise and give parents clear, actionable guidance when they need it most.
whyBabyHealth.quote: "Access to reliable guidance should not depend on time of day, location, or the anxiety of uncertainty."
whyBabyHealth.purpose: We created Project Aurora to serve as a warm, responsive digital hand to guide you, helping you understand when to soothe, when to wait, and when to seek clinical care.

transparency.title: Transparency and safety first
transparency.subtitle: Technology that supports. Never replaces.
transparency.description: We believe in ethical AI. This is exactly what BabyHealth does and what we strictly avoid.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.description: BabyHealth does not provide medical services. Always consult a healthcare professional for clinical concerns.
